notes: Cash-basis village. Governmental lines from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p4, Total Governmental Funds); business-type from the proprietary statement (p6-7), which ties to the Statement of Activities (p1-2). Interfund transfers (General (15,741) / Street 15,741; Electric (86,301) / Sewer 86,301) net to zero in the total columns, so top-level transfers and transfers_net are null; they appear in detail. Debt proceeds 366,300 printed under other financing sources (Street Fund). Cash and fund balance kept separate: only fund balances are rolled forward; cash/CD lines are on the balance sheet (ending_cash null as in later years). 'Other intergovernmental sources' split using the Street Fund budget schedule (p10: highway allocation 58,018 + motor vehicle taxes 4,347 + highway incentive 600 = Street column 62,965). Grants have no grantor printed (category other, detail Grants). Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining schedule (p11; more detailed than the p8-9 budget schedule, which is not recorded); Street Fund budget schedule (p10); utility combining schedule per fund (p12). The General Fund 'Other' department mixes public safety, culture/recreation and economic development (p4 function totals less Police/Park), so its lines are category other. Read pages 1-12 of 12
